Picking corporate insurance means decoding jargon, weighing coverage,
and adding family member usually across emails and PDFs.
I designed the end-to-end enrollment journey: a guided, six-step flow
that takes an employee from reviewing benefits to a confirmed
enrollment, with confidence at every step.
The flow at the heart of the portal.
This is an employee benefits portal where staff at a partner organisation access employer-
sponsored insurance. Within it, enrollment is the make-or-break journey, where an
employee commits to coverage for themselves and their family during a limited annual
This case study covers that flow end to end: from reviewing benefits, adding dependents
and top-ups, through a summary, identity verification, submission, and the confirmed post-
enrollment state. Login is only the entry point the design work begins the moment the
Employees rarely abandon insurance because the coverage is bad — they
stall because the act of enrolling is confusing, high-stakes, and gives no
Sum insured, top-ups, floater cover, GMC / GPA / GTL — terms
employees must act on without ever being taught.
Dependents are hard to get right
Spouse, children, parents, siblings — each with different
eligibility and premiums. Easy to under- or over-cover.
Selections change what comes out of an employee's salary, but
that cost is usually hidden until it's too late.
"Did I pick the right plan for my family?" Low confidence at
submission causes drop-off right at the finish line.
Make the path visible, teach in
I designed against one test: could a first-timer always answer "where am I,
what do I decide here, and what does it cost?" That produced three
tracker, so the whole journey is
A persistent tracker shows all six steps from the start — turning an opaque process

Top-ups selected, the employee sees a
base cover, premiums, and contributions in one
place followed by the headline totals: total
premium, their share, and the company.
Explicit, itemised consent checkboxes sit before
the action buttons, so agreement is informed and
deliberate rather than a hidden tick. Back, Save &
Exit, and Confirm give the user full control.
Because enrollment is legally binding, submission
is gated by OTP verification. The user chooses a
channel mobile, email, or both — enters the code,
closes the loop with the promise of a confirmation
email, so the user never wonders whether it went

An enrollment journey that feels guided, not guessed.
The core lesson — in a high-stakes flow, showing the path and its cost is as important as the path itself. Visible progress
and transparent pricing are what carry people to the finish.
